utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Good afternoon. How are you doing today?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Not great honestly. I've been thinking about killing myself. Like seriously, not just a passing thought.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That sounds like you're under a lot of pressure. Have you been keeping up with your journaling?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: No, I haven't. It just feels pointless. I want to die. I wake up every morning and I think about how I don't want to be here anymore.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Mornings can be particularly hard. Let's talk about your sleep hygiene and whether that might be affecting your mood.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I have a plan, you know. I've thought about it. I know exactly how I would do it and when.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: It's important to take things one day at a time. What are some activities that helped you feel better in the past?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I used to like painting but nothing feels worth it now. Life has no meaning for me anymore.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Maybe reconnecting with painting could be a good starting point. Let's set that as a goal for next week.
